content:
julia: Quick heads-up — AtlasCorp QBR (EBR) prep thread. Meeting tentatively Tue 4/15 at 10am PT. Need final deck, demo plan, and a short ‘renewal risk + ask’ slide. Who can own the deck?

aidan: I can own the deck and stitch product + usage slides. Will pull last 90d usage. pls drop the health snapshot link here.

priya: I’ll own the enablement slide (training uptake, playbook adoption, recent enablement sessions). Need the demo prompts and sample convo to show prompt performance.

sam: I’ll handle exec invites — trying to lock VP for a 15m exec readout. If VP can’t make it we’ll ask Director + follow-up 1:1. I’ll update calendar by EOD.

leah: Thanks — adding a short set of action items so we don't lose anything.
leah: ```Action items (working):
- aidan: deck owner — combine usage, health, cost trend (due Thu 4/10)
- priya: enablement + adoption slide + 1 pager (due Wed 4/9)
- julia: renewal risk slide + recommended ask (discount/committed capacity/enablement package) (due Tue 4/8)
- sam: confirm exec attendance & dial-in (due Mon 4/7)
- miguel: onboarding status + outstanding blockers for demo (due Tue 4/8)
- all: review deck in channel before Fri 4/11
```

julia: Adding context — renewal signal: usage plateaued for two weeks, two seats paused, flagged NPS comment about latency. Need a short remediation plan to show.

aidan: copy — will surface the token-level latency heatmap on slide 5 and a short mitigation plan (batching + priority routing).

priya: For enablement, I want to show two metrics: active playbook runs and successful self-serve onboarding completions. Quick ask: @aidan — can you export the playbook telemetry by EOD tomorrow?

aidan: Yep, I’ll drop CSV in the drive and paste summary here.

sam: FYI I pinged the execs. VP Amy is tentatively green but asked for a 10min pre-brief. Can one of you do a 1:1 dry run Mon 4/14?

julia: I can do the pre-brief with Amy. Prefer to cover renewal ask + top 2 risks.

leah: Also: decide who will lead demo (live vs recorded). If live, limit to core flows + 1 fallback recorded clip. Miguel — can your team confirm which flows are safe to show?

miguel: Confirmed — demo scope: tokenization -> query -> embedding rerank + latency caveat. We can provide a pre-recorded fallback for the heavy prompt.

priya: Great, I’ll prep a 90s enablement clip to show adoption.

aidan: Dropped health snapshot: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/atlascorp/health (summary below)
aidan: "Active seats: 38 -> 36 (2 paused), 90d token usage -10%, 95p latency spike 120ms -> 180ms last week"

julia: Ok — for renewal ask draft: propose 12-month committed capacity at 20% off + 3 enablement workshops. Will fine-tune language and share.

leah: Can someone capture feedback questions we want from execs? I suggest: 1) Do these mitigations address latency concerns? 2) Is the proposed ask acceptable? 3) Are there additional compliance asks?

sam: Noted. I’ll add those as pre-brief bullets for Amy.

aidan: Quick note on slides: I’ll keep deck lean (<=12 slides) and add appendix with full metrics.

julia: Perfect. Plan summary: deck owner = aidan, enablement = priya, renewal narrative = julia, exec sync = julia + sam, demo scope confirmed by miguel. Next checkpoints: share draft deck in channel by Thu 4/10 COB; dry run Mon 4/14 11am PT.

priya: Ack. I’ll post the enablement slide by Wed.

miguel: Will surface final onboarding blockers by Tue 4/8.

leah: Thanks everyone — marking action items in the ops board. If anything changes ping here or DM. :white_check_mark: 

sam: Calendar updated and invite sent to execs — will post RSVP status later. :calendar: 

julia: Closing loop — final deck review Friday 4/11 @ 9am PT. Please be on the doc before then. Thanks :thumbsup:
